learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialty, at the level necessary to acquire the remaining competencies of the degree, including notions of the latest advances.
Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

The ability to analyze complex products, processes, and systems in their field of study; choose and apply relevant analytical, calculation, and experimental methods already established and correctly interpret the results of said analyses.

The ability to identify, formulate and solve engineering problems in their specialty; appropriately choose and apply established analytical, calculation, and experimental methods; recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial constraints.

Ability to perform bibliographic searches, consult and use databases and other information sources critically, to carry out simulation and analysis with the aim of conducting research on technical topics in their specialty.
Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes in their specialty.
Capacity and skill to design and carry out experimental research, interpret results and reach conclusions in their field of study.
Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, design, and research and their limitations in the scope of their specialty.
Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects and conduct research specific to their specialty.
Knowledge of application of materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes and their limitations in the scope of their specialty.
Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their specialty.
Knowledge of the social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial implications of engineering practice.
Ability to collect and interpret data and handle complex concepts within their specialty, to make judgments that involve reflection on ethical and social issues.
Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and cooperate with engineers as well as people from other disciplines.
Ability to stay up-to-date with developments in science and technology.
Know the numerical simulation methods for sheet metal forming production processes.
Know the numerical simulation methods for casting production processes.
Know the numerical simulation methods for forging production processes.

assessment_methods.method: Reports on exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices

assessment_rules: Assessment is based 100% on reports of exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices. Recovery mechanisms include resubmission of these types of reports.
bibliography: Manufactura. Ingeniería y Tecnología. Serope Kalpakjian y Steven R. Schmid. Pearson Education
